embedding.note: embedded in 4 document shards on a 32 vCPU VM; vectors only, timing not part of the comparison

protocol.warm_up: one untimed pass over the queries before the timed passes
protocol.retrieval: exact cosine top-10 over the same 384-dimension document vectors from one file; query vectors supplied (query embedding is outside the timer for every system and is shared)
protocol.timing: one query at a time from one Node process; each call awaited and the hit ids read inside the timer. Vectra `LocalIndex.queryItems` and warm-memory `warm-memory/vectra` `queryItems` (mode exact) for the dense rows; `searchDocuments` for the WARM hybrid and lexical rows
protocol.cold_start: process start (node and module load included) to the end of the first query
protocol.build: fresh process per repeat; vectors are read from disk before the timer; WARM builds `warm-vector` (vector records) and `warm-docs` (documents with their embeddings, text not stored, one chunk per document); Vectra builds `LocalIndex.batchInsertItems`
protocol.size: allocated bytes of the store directory (du)
protocol.peak_rss: wait4 rusage of the serve or build process
protocol.interleaving: each round runs every row once in a fresh process, order rotated per round
protocol.vectra_bm25: Vectra's isBm25 rebuilds a BM25 engine over every non-selected item per query (about 100 ms at 300 documents) and runs out of heap after about 20 queries in one process, so each round measures 0 queries (set per dataset: its cost grows with the corpus text) in a fresh process, one timed pass, no warm-up. Its list is the 10 semantic hits followed by BM25 hits, so nDCG@10 and recall@10 are those of the dense row by construction.
protocol.docreader: Vectra's BM25 path reads each chunk's text through `docReader`; the benchmark supplies it from memory, which favours Vectra (its default reads one file per document per query)

vectra.keyword: Vectra 0.15.0 has no keyword-only query: `queryItems(vector, query, topK, filter, isBm25)` always runs the vector scan first and `isBm25` only appends BM25 hits (from `wink-bm25-text-search`) after the semantic list; there is no fusion.

not_run.vectra-bm25: Vectra's isBm25 rebuilds a BM25 engine over every item per query; its cost grows with the corpus (about 46 s per query at 4,559 LongMemEval sessions, 6 to 8 s at 3,600 to 5,200 short documents), so at 57,600 documents the row was not run (WARM_BENCH_JS_BM25_QUERIES=0).
